title: Show HN: A zoomable timeline of 4M Wikipedia events
summary: A side-project demonstrating a zoomable timeline interface built with Kotlin Multiplatform, used to visualize 4 million Wikipedia events scored by PageRank for a journal app. The timeline allows users to zoom in/out and explore historical events at different granularities.
problem_solved: Makes millions of historical Wikipedia events navigable and explorable through an intuitive zoomable timeline interface for journaling purposes.
why_valuable: Combines personal journaling with world history exploration, offering a novel way to contextualize daily events within the broader scope of historical significance.
